purpose: Preserve recorded agent-request transmissions in a natural-activity, enriched case-control EEG cohort while keeping the existing v2 subject split and v1 model run unchanged.
preparation_device: CPU only; no GPU or LLM execution

inclusion.subject_assignments: Copy parent subject_split.json byte-for-byte; never re-rank or re-split.
inclusion.minimum_environment_timestamp: At or before EEG window start minus clock guard.

case_definition.label: ai_prompt_submit
case_definition.meaning: Observed request transmission to the agent; no latent-intent inference.

control_definition.role: Other observed actions, not idle or no-intention labels.

selection.case_priority: Select valid case windows first within each recording, ordered by event time then acquisition/row ID; reject later overlapping case windows.
selection.overlap_rule: All selected [first_sample,last_sample) EEG input windows within a recording must be disjoint; touching endpoints are permitted.
selection.control_matching: For recordings with retained cases, match each case stratum's last pre-EEG oTree AI-availability value. Sum quotas within a stratum, then select controls.
selection.control_order: Within each recording/availability stratum/label, ascending SHA256(seed:recording_id:acquisition:evidence_row). Selection is independent of EEG values and model predictions.
selection.zero_case_matching: If a recording has no retained cases, retain up to eight real controls without availability restriction so zero-request subjects remain represented.
selection.unmet_quota: Record the deficit; do not invent, duplicate, synthesize, or replace labels after seeing performance.

features: time since most recent event, capped to 60 seconds; null when absent
history_features.target_guard: Both cutoffs must be strictly before event_time_s; only source onsets strictly below the chosen cutoff enter a feature.
history_features.interpretation: Two declared time horizons: conservative history preceding EEG, and stronger action-history-only control available by the guarded decision time. Neither is future target evidence.

analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: Observed ai_prompt_submit versus other observed actions; report recall, specificity, balanced accuracy, AUROC/AUPRC with subject-cluster uncertainty and explicit case-control prevalence.
analysis_plan.secondary_endpoint: Three-class observed-action balanced accuracy, macro F1, confusion matrix, and class support.
comparison: Recorded-history-only baseline at guarded predecision cutoff
EEG/fused model and its existing EEG-shuffle/time-shift/input-ablation controls
analysis_plan.model_selection: Validation subjects only; test subjects remain held out until the preregistered comparison is frozen.
analysis_plan.precision_scope: Precision, AUPRC, calibration and coverage apply only to the enriched sample; they do not estimate natural-population precision, false actions/minute or task completion.
analysis_plan.goal_status: Still blocked for online latent-intent/agent-goal claims; no invented intent labels.
analysis_plan.source_hours_note: v3 reuses the same source recordings as v2; do not add v2 and v3 hours as independent data.
